en.headline: Tang says joint task force will seek bid-rigging clues at owners’ meetings
en.dek: Security Secretary tells lawmakers officers will use surveillance and attend corporation meetings to intervene early in building maintenance cases.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang told a joint meeting of the Legislative Council’s Panel on Security and Panel on Economic Development on Tuesday that the interdepartmental task force on combating bid-rigging in building maintenance would proactively look for clues rather than wait for complaints.

Tang said officers from the police, the Independent Commission Against Corruption and the Competition Commission would attend owners’ corporation meetings at high-risk buildings to watch for suspicious activities, such as people holding large numbers of proxy votes or suspected triad members engaging in harassment or intimidation.

The government has said it aims to criminalise serious anti-competitive conduct related to building maintenance tenders, including bid-rigging, by April next year. Tang said the task force’s establishment would enable early intervention through tactics such as surveillance, undercover operations and the use of informants.

Authorities have stepped up measures against bid-rigging following the independent committee report into the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po. Tang said officers would take enforcement action when necessary.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強稱特遣隊會到業主大會尋找圍標線索
zh.dek: 保安局局長向立法會議員表示，執法人員會出席業主立案法團會議並以監視等方式及早介入樓宇維修個案。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強周二在立法會保安事務委員會及經濟發展事務委員會聯席會議上表示，打擊樓宇維修圍標的跨部門特遣隊會主動尋找線索，而非等待投訴。
鄧炳強說，警隊、廉政公署及競爭事務委員會的人員會出席高風險大廈的業主立案法團會議，留意可疑活動，例如有人持有大量授權票，或懷疑三合會成員進行騷擾或恐嚇。
政府表示目標在明年4月前將與樓宇維修工程招標相關的嚴重反競爭行為刑事化，包括圍標。鄧炳強指特遣隊的成立有助及早介入，方法包括監視、臥底行動及使用線人。
當局在大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會報告後加強打擊圍標措施。鄧炳強說執法人員在有需要時會採取執法行動。
